description: This file defines the interface for the 'bml_iter_node' class, which is a subclass of 'bml_iter_base' and provides iteration functionality for a node in the BML (possibly a hardware or network node). It declares a constructor, destructor, and an override of the 'next()' method.

classes.name: bml_iter_node
classes.description: An iteration class for a node in the BML, extending the base iterator class 'bml_iter_base'.

methods.name: bml_iter_node
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an iterator with a specified number of elements and a data buffer.

methods.name: ~bml_iter_node
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources associated with the iterator.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next node and returns the result status.
